label: Does the PSR-collapse family exclude a necessitating impersonal source at the will step?
summary: See docs/notes/will-versus-chance.md section 2. Already established before this slice: in each fixed sense of a necessitating source (strict efficacy of one rigid act, #555 rigid_core with ModalSenseSupport.RivalNegations refuting NecessaryActStrictlyYieldsContingent; fixed giving, #1897 laws 3-4; necessitating reason, PSRStrength.necessitating_reason_contingent) a necessary source of a contingent effect is excluded by K-closure. The brief's proposed joint-satisfiability test is therefore already answered negatively and was not re-proved. New only as a connection: the will step's set-up sense (SetupNecessitatedAt, DEF ca00e246), with set-up collapse, VG as set-up necessitation under excluded middle, and the withholding holder not set-up necessitated whatever its power (controls laws 8-10, result ec6627bf). The exclusion is indifferent to personality: it excludes a necessitated will equally (law 2), so it removes Spinozist emanation of the actual contingents only together with requiring the theist's will to be non-necessitating toward creatures. A NECESSITATE disambiguation over the four senses was drafted and dropped (it would have forced re-tagging existing labels; no argument uses two senses).
